answer: Shared-signature escrow links. Each agent gets a private key split across three escrow agents; any action signs with all three shards, and mismatched shard sets are logged publicly. Sybil duplicates require assembling separate shard triples, each costing a full setup cycle plus a glacier-slow audit delay before activation. The cost compounds per copy, so reaching sybil zenith becomes economically absurd. Each duplicate also leaves a relic trace in the public log, making replication self-revealing to any observer.
